summary: Tested the new features on the backend and frontend: login eye toggle and validation, admin management (list, create, activate/deactivate) and the content audit trail for blogs, services and conditions. Backend: 27 of 27 pytest tests passed. One test was skipped because psql is not installed. The bcrypt check was done separately with Prisma and every hash starts with $2b$12$. Frontend: every requested flow passed in Playwright on the c6816511 host. Login also works on prevent-restore.preview.emergentagent.com now, so the cross-origin issue from iteration_1 is resolved. No functional bugs found.

minor.issue: The 'last active admin' check (count, then update) does not run in a transaction. If two admins deactivate each other at the same moment, both requests can pass the check and leave zero active admins. Fix: do the count and the update inside prisma.$transaction (serializable), or use a conditional update. Found by code review only.

A deactivated account returns 403 only when the password is correct; a wrong password returns 401. This reveals whether the password is correct for deactivated accounts. Low risk and acceptable, but worth noting.

ui_bugs.issue: The server error 'Invalid email or password' (login-error) stays on screen while the user retypes the email or password. It only clears on the next submit. Low priority UX issue.

verified_flows: Login: eye toggle switches the password field between password and text, and its aria-label changes. Empty submit shows 'Email is required' and 'Password is required' with no API call. A bad email shows 'Enter a valid email address' with no API call. A wrong password shows 'Invalid email or password'. A valid login redirects to /admin.
Sidebar nav-admins goes to /admin/admins. admins-table shows ID, name, email, Active/Deactivated status and created date. The current user's row has the 'You' badge and no toggle button.

Create admin modal: required-field errors for name, email and password; bad email; password under 10 characters; password with no digits; password mismatch. The eye toggle works on both password fields. Duplicate email shows create-admin-email-error 'An admin with this email address already exists'. A successful create closes the modal, adds the row and shows a toast.

Deactivate via UI: confirm dialog, then status shows Deactivated. The other admin's open session is redirected to /admin/login?next=. Their login shows 'This account has been deactivated. Contact another administrator.' After reactivation, login works again.

API: 401 without a cookie. 422 for invalid payloads and for changing your own status. 404 for an unknown id. 409 for a duplicate email, including a different-case version of the same email. passwordHash is never in responses.

Audit trail on blog 8 (editor), a new TEST service and a new TEST condition: created-by stays 'TEST QA Admin (ID 2)' and updated-by changes to the second admin after their edit. Publish and unpublish set updatedBy to the admin who acted. The panel is hidden on /new.
Override attempt: createdById, updatedById and createdBy sent in the request body are ignored; the session admin is recorded.
Seeded services show 'Not recorded' with the note 'Created before audit tracking (seeded content).'
Pages: create and update work and the response has no createdBy field. The UI check for pages was not run because no pages exist.
Public list and detail APIs for blogs, services and conditions contain no createdBy, updatedBy or admin emails.

critical_code_review_comments: adminUsersController.setStatus: the last-active-admin guard is not atomic (race condition).
Deactivation increments sessionVersion, so old tokens stay invalid even after reactivation. This is good.
requireAuth checks isActive on every request. This is good.
Audit fields are applied after cfg.toData, so the body cannot override them. This is correct.
